projects.name: & Development for Gen AI | Build architecture for Gen AI solutions | Resource planning based on client budget
details: KEY PROJECTS EXECUTED
GEN-AI
Sentiment Analysis & Call Reasons – Analysed 2 years of daily call transcripts between different customers & call-center agents

using Gen AI. Based on the analysis, obtained the sentiment of customer during the call and grouped it into Satisfied/Unsatisfied/Angry. Reason for which the call was made was also identified. The results for each conversation id was stored
in a SQL table which in turn was used in the building Power Bi Dashboards to give meaningful insights. This was a POC which was
approved as a project. Proposed the architecture for the solution and it was successfully deployed into production.
Player Summary – For an ongoing sport league, web scrape most recent information based on form, availability & injury and
provide a summary for each player which would help the users to make an informed decision to build their teams in betting apps.
This was a POC which was successfully converted into a project. Proposed and presented the architecture for this solution and the
RFP.
Product Recommendation – Based on user requirements in terms of utility, budget & preferences the gen ai app will web scrape
the latest information available on similar products and recommend the best two products for the customers.
This was a POC that helped me receive an award in the organization.
TIME SERIES FORECASTING
Forecasting Sales of Beer in US and Canada – Built a timeseries forecasting model using Prophet and Log-Log method to forecast
the sales of Beer in US and Canada at every month. Identified the key regressors which is driving the growth / decline and the
impact it had on the forecasting.

projects.name: & Development | Proof of Concept to Production | Develop end-to-end data science solutions |
details: Led 12+ data scientists | SME Collaboration | Suggested cost & process efficient tools & approaches
KEY PROJECTS EXECUTED
REGRESSION
Digital Calibration Frequency - Designed, developed and deployed a linear regression model for predicting the number of days
for the next calibration of devices, using Weibull Analysis and Azure Databricks. Automated CI/CD pipelines to handle changes
without manual intervention
Predicting Concentration Value - Predicted the concentration value for a spectrum dataset using PCA and SVM Regressor.
Principal Component Analysis was used to reduce the dimensionality of the dataset and replicate the functionalities of an existing
tool including the Hotelling T2 plots. The model achieved 100% accuracy in matching the predictions with the existing tool.
CLASSIFICATION
Product Classification - Developed a multi-class logistic regression model to predict the category of products based on input
values. Deployed the model as a pickle file into Azure Blob, and created an API to predict the results each time a new file is
uploaded. Also created CI/CD PIPELINES TO HANDLE CHANGES WITHOUT MANUAL INTERVENTION.
NATURAL LANGUAGE PROCESSING
Data Linkage – Phrase Extraction - Led efforts in the extraction of Site Information, Location, and Address details from available
text information using Fuzzy Matching and Levenshtein distance algorithms. Deployed the model into an in-house platform,
and the project was approved for the next phase
RSC - Developed a proof-of-concept that used FastText and Jaccard Similarity to generate a maximum similarity score between
two addresses above the threshold limit and assign the address to the predictive field. Applied standard text cleaning techniques
to remove special characters and punctuation. Project assigned to Physical Manufacturer.
Insights - Key Phrase Extraction & Summary - Developed and deployed a model for key phrase extraction and summarizing
customer reviews and complaints. Used TF-IDF and Word & Sentence Tokenization to clean and analyze the text, and generated
summaries based on a threshold limit. Deployed Model in an in-house platform and the output were very useful to the end user
TIME SERIES
Forecasting OEE - Developed a forecasting model for Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) of different machines using
XGBoost. Used key fields that decide the OEE value of the machines and the data was stored in a database. The training and
prediction codes were deployed into an Azure Virtual Machine and a cron-job was created to run the codes as per the
requirements. The model was saved into Azure Blob Storage and also created CI/CD pipelines for deployment
Anomaly Detection of Sensors – Led anomaly detection of sensors by using static thresholding. Analyzed IOT data received from
sensors and used it to forecast anomalies. Fixed a threshold limit of temperature and classified those points as anomalies.
IMAGE CLASSIFICATION
Contact Lens Defect Identification - Developed an automated defect recognition tool for contact lenses using a Convolutional
Neural Network (CNN) with RELU activation. The images were converted to black and white using adaptive thresholding and
morphological operations such as MORPH_RECT, erode and dilate were used to detect any lines in the contact lens images. The
model achieved an accuracy of 98%, reducing costs and manual effort by 70%
